items.lede: Apple developers will have to declare whether their app enables dating between real people and/or AI companions, so the company can apply the proper age rating.
items.title: Apple will start mandating age requirements for dating apps

items.title: Apple is restricting dating apps and romanceable chatbots to over 18s

items.lede: Apple's new App Store rules will require 18+ ratings for dating apps and AI companions that offer sexual or romantic content.
items.title: Apple restricts dating apps and AI companions to users 18 and up
